mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_id,arrival_at,destination FROM t_trips WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_trips SET arrival_snapshot_url=#{url},arrival_city=#{city},arrival_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND arrival_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notifications(id,user_id,kind,title,body,order_id) SELECT UUID(),o.buyer_id,'arrival',CONCAT('带单人已到达',COALESCE(NULLIF(#{city},''),t.destination),'（到城留证）'),'带单人已上传到城自拍与定位，请留意当面交付或寄出安排',o.id FROM t_orders o JOIN t_trips t ON t.id=o.trip_id WHERE o.trip_id=#{tripId} AND o.status IN ('locked','purchased')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_trips WHERE carry_mode='pool' AND pool_status IN ('none','forming') AND status='active' AND return_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,buyer_id,vendor_id,buyer_deposit_status,vendor_deposit_status,buyer_deposit,vendor_deposit,service_fee FROM t_orders WHERE trip_id=#{tripId} AND pool_slot_no IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('requesting','negotiating','vendor_deposit_pending','locked') ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET status='cancelled_no_fault',buyer_deposit_status='refunded',vendor_deposit_status=CASE WHEN vendor_deposit_status='frozen' THEN 'refunded' ELSE vendor_deposit_status END,cancel_reason_type='mutual_agreement' WHERE id=#{orderId} AND status IN ('requesting','negotiating','vendor_deposit_pending','locked')
UPDATE t_trips SET pool_status='expired' WHERE id=#{tripId} AND pool_status IN ('none','forming')
